title: MineDojo Voyager: open-ended embodied agent
content_excerpt: Voyager is an LLM-powered embodied lifelong learning agent in Minecraft with an automatic curriculum, an ever-growing executable skill library, and iterative prompting that incorporates environment feedback, execution errors, and self-verification.
evidence_notes: Reference for AI-specific Minecraft decision structure: curriculum, skill library, environment feedback, self-verification, and failure-driven refinement.
related_game_versions: Java Edition versions used by the project
notes: Use for architecture and decision-process lessons, not as proof that every strategy works in dsv4.1 or the current project setup.
